## Type Aliases

### AppFileRead

```ts
type AppFileRead = Disposable & object;
```

A parent-owned read. Closing it aborts the parent HTTP operation.

#### Type Declaration

| Name         | Type                          | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `response()` | () => `Promise`\<`Response`\> | Resolve with the underlying Response once it is available.      |
| `close()`    | () => `Promise`\<`void`\>     | Release the parent's open read, aborting it if still in flight. |

### AppFileWrite

```ts
type AppFileWrite = Disposable & object;
```

A parent-owned upload; close requests transport abort, never promises rollback.

#### Type Declaration

| Name      | Type                               | Description                                                     |
| --------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `write()` | (`content`) => `Promise`\<`void`\> | Stream the upload's content to the parent-owned destination.    |
| `close()` | () => `Promise`\<`void`\>          | Request that the parent abort or finalize the upload transport. |

### writeAppFile()

```ts
function writeAppFile(write, content, options): Promise<void>;
```

Stream a Blob's bytes to a parent-owned upload. Aborting `signal` closes the
upload early; a close failure after a successful write is reported, never
thrown, since it cannot change an already-acknowledged commit.

#### Parameters

| Parameter         | Type                            |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `write`           | [`AppFileWrite`](#appfilewrite) |
| `content`         | `Blob`                          |
| `options`         | \{ `signal?`: `AbortSignal`; \} |
| `options.signal?` | `AbortSignal`                   |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>
